• Option 1 "Declare" means to make something publicly and officially known — different in sense from "disconsolate".

• Option 2 "Peculiar" means unconventional or slightly strange in behavior — different in sense from "disconsolate".

• Option 3 "Surrender" means to cease resistance and submit to an opponent — different in sense from "disconsolate".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of disconsolate: unhappy. Antonyms: cheerful, consoled.

solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Commotion.

• "Confusion" means a state of uncertainty, disorder, or bewilderment. Its closest synonym among the options is "commotion". (भ्रम)

◦ Example: The sudden announcement of the exam's postponement caused widespread confusion (commotion) among students waiting outside the examination hall.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Concur" means to accept or agree to something without protest — different in sense from "confusion".

• Option 2 "Nurture" means care for and hold dear with deep affection — different in sense from "confusion".

• Option 4 "Fire" means a large and destructive fire — different in sense from "confusion".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of confusion: commotion. Antonyms: clarity, order.
